reviews.title: Free?
reviews.text: This rather dubious piece of software claims to be free. I am not sure that the developer understands the meaning of the word free. If you look at the in app purchases, there are various weekly charges listed, between £6 to £9. This means that if you want to use it, you have to pay, therefore it is not free! It is also contrary to this countries legislation, as if something is described as free, it must be free! No doubt the developer will claim he lives elsewhere and so the law does not apply to him!
